name: The American Club Resort
insider_take: This isn't just a resort—it's America's only AAA Five Diamond resort hotel, where Midwest hospitality meets world-class luxury in the charming village of Kohler.
whats_special: Built as a dormitory for immigrant workers in 1918, The American Club transformed into an ultra-luxe resort while preserving its Tudor Revival architecture. The property sits in the heart of Kohler—a company town created by the famous plumbing fixture family—and features four championship golf courses designed by legends like Pete Dye and Jack Nicklaus.
pro_tip: Book the Kohler Waters Spa's signature "Vichy shower" treatment—it uses the same pristine water that flows through Kohler's legendary fixtures, creating a uniquely luxurious hydrotherapy experience.
dont_miss: Explore the adjacent Shops at Woodlake for exclusive Kohler products and artisan goods, then catch a performance at the intimate John Michael Kohler Arts Center, known for its cutting-edge contemporary art exhibitions and artist residency program.
pros: Historic luxury resort with distinctive Tudor-style architecture
World-class Kohler Waters Spa with extensive wellness facilities
Championship golf courses including Whistling Straits nearby
Multiple award-winning restaurants and fine dining options
cons: Remote Wisconsin location requires travel planning
Premium pricing for luxury amenities and services
